subject: Clarifying GCP marketplace withholding and reclaim path for EdgeScale April invoice
body:
From: Avery Collins <invoices@edgescale.co>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@edgescale.co
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: EdgeScale April invoice — GCP withholding showing on payout

Hi Vanessa,

We got the April payout summary and one of the line items shows a GCP marketplace withholding adjustment that reduced the remittance to EdgeScale by EUR 6,420. The invoice we submitted (attached) was for EUR 64,200; the payout shows the net amount and an unexplained withholding line labeled "Tax Withholding - Marketplace". Could you confirm whether Redwood is passing through GCP withholdings or whether this is being withheld by the marketplace?

Attachment: EdgeScale_Invoice_APR2028.pdf (pdf, 12KB)

Best,
Avery Collins
Revenue Ops, EdgeScale

-----
On Fri, 10 Nov 2028 at 09:12, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com> wrote:
Received and logging — forwarding to finance and marketplace ops to investigate.

--- Message forwarded ---
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 09:28:13 -0800
Subject: Fwd: EdgeScale April invoice — GCP withholding showing on payout

Team — forwarding EdgeScale's note. They say a "Tax Withholding - Marketplace" line was applied to their payout. It reduced their April remittance by EUR 6.4k. Please: (1) Check the marketplace payout statement and confirm whether the withholding was applied by GCP (or by AWS if this was re-routed), (2) If it was withheld on our side, outline reclaim path and timeline. This is a partner account on Redwood's partner marketplace program — we need to preserve partner economics.

Quick context: EdgeScale sells via GCP Marketplace on multiple entities — they are EU-registered; they may be impacted by local VAT withholding when marketplaces route through a different tax entity.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <finance_ops@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 10:03:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeScale April invoice — initial findings

Vanessa — I pulled the marketplace payout artifacts. See attached statement (partial) and the triage CSV run against our metering exports. Initial notes:

- The withholding line appears in the consolidated payout file we received from GCP Marketplace (file: AWS-Marketplace-Payout-Statement-2028-04.pdf). The label is generic and the holding entity is listed as "Marketplace Tax Service S.à r.l." in the statement metadata.
- Payout gross aligns to EdgeScale's invoice gross (EUR 64,200). Withholding amount = EUR 6,420 (10%). That 10% looks like a VAT/withholding applied at the marketplace aggregation entity.
- The metering export shows a split across two internal SKU mappings we use for EdgeScale (eu-west1 usage vs global sku), and a downstream routing to an internal ledger entity that maps to Redwood EU Marketplace (merchant_of_record_id: EU-REDWOOD-01).

Next steps I recommend: (a) request the marketplace withholding certificate/document from GCP/AWS; (b) confirm whether the withheld amount is eligible for reclaim by the seller (EdgeScale) via local refund or reclaim through the marketplace; (c) if reclaimable, prepare support packet for EdgeScale and request timeline.

Attachments: GCP_Marketplace_Report_Q2-Q3-2028.csv, AWS-Marketplace-Payout-Statement-2028-04.pdf (pdf, CSV)

-Marissa
Senior Revenue Accountant, Redwood Inference

-----
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 11:12:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: EdgeScale April invoice — compliance & reclaim guidance

Marissa, Vanessa — good triage. Two compliance strands here: (1) tax/regulatory (VAT withholding) applied by marketplace entity; (2) contract terms between Redwood and marketplace and Redwood and EdgeScale (do we indemnify or pass-through?).

Per Redwood standard partner T&Cs, we are not the tax authority — we should escalate to GCP/AWS to get the official withholding certificate and the legal basis. If the marketplace can issue a reclaim to the seller, there are two common options:
 - Marketplace issues a refund to the seller after the seller files local reclaim paperwork (seller-managed).
 - Marketplace issues a tax credit to the merchant of record that can be passed through on next settlement (marketplace-managed).

Ask: Neha, can you confirm whether our partner onboarding docs for EdgeScale (region EU) included any language about marketplace withholding? If we accepted pass-through, we need to coordinate with EdgeScale on reclaim paperwork; if not, we may need to consider a credit to the partner. Also, ask Procurement on EdgeScale side whether they have a local VAT reg number to support reclaim.

-Hannah Schmitt
VP, Legal & Compliance

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Avery Collins <invoices@edgescale.co>, procurement@edgescale.co
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, AWS Marketplace Billing <billing@amazonaws.com>
Bcc: finance_ops@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Nov 2028 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: EdgeScale April invoice — GCP withholding showing on payout

Hi Avery — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the disruption. We're actively investigating. Quick summary of findings so far: the withholding line appears on the marketplace payout statement and is recorded as a 10% withholding by the marketplace aggregator. We've asked AWS/GCP marketplace billing to send the official withholding notice and the reclaim instructions.

Immediate options for EdgeScale:
1) If EdgeScale has local VAT registration and the marketplace accepts seller-initiated reclaim, they can file for refund directly (timeline typically 6-12 weeks depending on country).
2) If marketplace-issued credit is available, Redwood will request a credit be applied to EdgeScale's next payout and expedite processing; this is usually faster but depends on marketplace policy.

To move quickly, please reply with EdgeScale's VAT registration number and a primary contact for local tax filings. We're happy to prepare the support packet (payout statement, original invoice, metering export).

Attachments: (we attached the partial payout PDF and the CSV extract to the secure drive link)
Drive link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/marketplace-reports/edgescale-2028

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Thanks Vanessa — appreciate the quick turnaround. EdgeScale VAT: GB123456789 (we operate EU entity in Ireland as well for EEA customers). Primary tax contact: Priya Menon <priya.menon@edgescale.co>. We would prefer a marketplace-issued credit if possible; seller-initiated reclaim is cumbersome. Please send the support packet to Priya and cc me.

If Redwood can get a marketplace credit applied to the May payout that would be ideal — welcome to invoice us for any processing admin fee if needed.

Attachment: none

Best,
Avery
Revenue Ops, EdgeScale
